entities.name: French Plantation Colony
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Under French rule, Grenada was developed into a sugar, indigo, and cotton plantation colony. Enslaved Africans were imported in large numbers to work the estates. French culture, Catholicism, and Creole language deeply influenced Grenadian society and persist to this day.
